strategy.positioning_statement: Peshawar's fully specialized Gynae + Pediatric hospital — end-to-end care (surgeries to medicines) from a trusted, doctor-led team, without the runaround of a general hospital.

logo.source: client-supplied (Desktop/Ilyas General Hospital/logo.png, background-removed version flattened onto white)

typography.heading: serif, condensed caps (arced wordmark style seen in the logo/posters)
